forgotPasswordDescription: We'll email you a link to reset it.
passwordResetEmailSentBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset your password.
resetPasswordError: That reset link is no longer valid.
signupEmailSentBody: We've sent a confirmation link to your email address.
verifyEmailRequiredBody: Your email address isn't confirmed yet. We've sent you a fresh confirmation link - open it, then log in again.
verifyEmailError: That verification link is no longer valid.
verifyEmailDeclinedBody: That email address was not confirmed.
providerErrorBody: That sign-in provider ran into an error. Try again.
providerErrorCancelledBody: You canceled before finishing. Nothing was changed.
providerErrorLoginsClosedBody: Signing in is limited to fewer people for the moment. Try again later.
completeSignupBody: Signed in as {{ email }}. Choose a username and password to finish.
completeSignupError: Could not finish signing you up.
profileEmailMakePrimaryError: Could not set email as primary.
profileConnectionsConnectError: Could not connect that account. Try again.
profileConnectionsConnectedOther: That account is already connected to a different user.
profileConnectionsPermissionDenied: Log in to connect an account.
profileSessionsOthersRevoked: Signed out of all other devices.
profileSessionsRevokeError: Unable to sign out of that device.
twoFactorTotpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactorRecoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each one works once.
twoFactorError: That code didn't work. Try again.
totpSetupHint: Scan this with an authenticator app, or type in the key, then enter the code it shows.
totpQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totpActivateError: Could not turn on two-factor authentication.
totpDeactivateError: Could not remove the authenticator app.
recoveryCodesHint: Save these somewhere safe now - they won't be shown again. Each works once.
recoveryCodesRegenerated: New recovery codes generated. The old ones no longer work.
recoveryCodesRegenerateError: Could not generate new recovery codes.
passkeyHint: Use a passkey or security key as your second step when you log in.
passkeyInsecureOrigin: Passkeys only work over a secure (https) connection.
proveDescription: For your security, confirm it's you before you continue.
proveSetPasswordHint: Your account has no password yet. We can email you a link to set one, and you can confirm with it afterwards.
proveSetPasswordAction: Email me a link to set a password
proveSetPasswordSent: We sent a link to {{ email }}. Set a password there, then come back to confirm with it.
proveFailed: We could not confirm it was you. Try again.
proveNoWay: There is no way to confirm it's you on this account. Contact support.
oauthConsentIntro: {{ application }} wants to use your {{ project }} account. It will be able to:
oauthConsentFootnote: You can take this back at any time from your profile.
profileAuthorizedApplicationsEmpty: No app can see your account.
registerApplicationTypeConfidential: A server, which keeps a secret
registerApplicationSecretHint: It is shown this once. If it is lost, make a new one from the app's page.
registerApplicationSecretDone: I have copied it, go to the app
validationRedirectUrisRequired: Add at least one redirect URI.
applicationsHint: Register an app so its users can sign in with their {{ project }} account, and let it act for them if they agree.
applicationsEmpty: You have not registered an app.
applicationsRegisterHint: It can sign people in once it is approved, and only ever asks each of them first.
applicationRequestedScopesLabel: What it asks to do for the people who sign in
applicationWaitingScopes: Waiting for a superuser before it can ask for: {{ scopes }}
applicationRotateHint: Make a new secret for the same client ID. The old one stops working at once.
applicationRotateRevoke: Also sign everybody out of it, in case the old secret is in somebody else's hands
applicationRotateError: Could not make a new secret.
applicationDisableHint: Nobody can sign in with it while it is off, and everybody already signed in is signed out.
applicationDisableError: Could not switch the app off.
applicationDisabledHint: It is off. Switch it back on, or delete it for good.
applicationRestoreError: Could not switch the app back on.
applicationPendingHint: A superuser has to approve it before it can sign anybody in.
applicationWithdrawnHint: A superuser withdrew it. Only a superuser can approve it again.
applicationReviewsHint: Every app registered here, the ones waiting for an answer first.
applicationReviewWithdrawHint: Withdrawing it signs everybody out of it, and nobody can sign in with it until it is approved again.
oauthErrorTitle: This app cannot sign you in
oauthErrorIntro: It is not one this project knows, or it is not approved right now. Nothing was shared with it.
peopleIsStaff: Staff: may sign in to the admin and read everybody's account
peopleReadOnly: You can read this account, but not change it.
peopleYourself: This is you. Somebody else changes what you may do.
profileApplicationsRegisterHint: Building an app that signs people in with this account?
applicationGrantRedirect: Signs people in through their browser
applicationGrantDevice: Shows a code to enter here, like a command line
registerApplicationDeviceHint: It shows people a code to enter at /device. It keeps no secret and is sent back nowhere, so there is nothing else to set.
deviceIntro: Enter the code your device shows.
deviceCodeUnknown: That code is wrong, has expired or was already used. Start again on the device.
deviceConsentIntro: A device running {{ application }} wants to use your {{ project }} account. Only allow it if you started this yourself. It will be able to:
deviceConsentCode: Check that your device shows {{ code }}.
deviceAllowed: Done. Go back to your device: it is signed in.
deviceDenied: Turned away. The device was told no.
deviceAnswerError: Could not answer the device. Start again on it.
profileTokensHint: A token lets a script or a command line call the API as you, with only what you give it. Keep it like a password.
profileTokensNeverWarning: A token that never expires works until you delete it. Pick an expiry unless you have a reason not to.
profileTokensIssuedHint: It is shown this once: only its checksum is kept. If you lose it, make another.
